# Final Implementation Plan

## Phase I — Character realism

Rewrite the complete character production files that must change, after reading all consumers. Split new responsibilities into small modules. Add face structure, anatomical torso, jointed arms, jointed legs, richer garment layers, and prop-side placement.

## Phase II — Object and set realism

Create a reusable office-object painter and motion resolver. Add a realistic office set. Extend the shared frame renderer to paint background, midground, carried, and foreground objects in deterministic layer order.

## Phase III — Text and camera language

Create character-anchored speech bubbles and safe layout. Keep title cards and text boxes. Author at least sixteen shots using wide, tracking, over-shoulder, insert, overhead, high, low, profile, Dutch, close-up, extreme close-up, two-shot, group, and final locked views.

## Phase IV — One-minute movie

Create `The Last Cup Before the Meeting` with three characters, twelve or more spoken lines, many actions, object interactions, camera cuts, text bubbles, title cards, and a clear setup/escalation/rescue/punchline structure. Compile it into the native NLE.

## Phase V — Export and proof

Add a dedicated exporter output directory, source artifacts, representative frames, exact scale courts, final sixty-second H.264/AAC movie, preview, FFprobe metadata, and SHA-256 hashes.

## Phase VI — Verification and challenge

Run focused realism/movie tests, syntax, imports, package/persistence, browser/runtime, scale courts, final export metadata, complete `npm run verify`, full touched-file compliance, readback, delta comparison, and final completion challenge.
